summary: Verified all requested new features + regression. 23/23 backend pytest cases pass (7-role login, retail 3-card seed with exact numbers/networks/statuses/expiries/issuer, UPI status/link/QR, all 4 role panels + RBAC, brute-force lockout NOW correctly firing at the 6th attempt thanks to X-Forwarded-For fix, plus prior CORS+PHP+bcrypt+banking regression). Frontend: public / home renders the white ICICI-style theme with 'National Bharat Bank' logo, personal/corporate/loans/investments nav, hero 'Banking made simple, secure & Bharat-ready', product grid and Quick Services box. Retail login → Cards & UPI tab shows all 3 card tiles with the exact seeded card numbers (4532 9845 2109 8821, 5241 7373 2160 2721, 5241 9548 3082 4607), holder RAHUL SHARMA, VISA/RuPay/mastercard network badges, 'Issued by Bank Only' subheader, freeze/PIN/hotlist/UPI icon actions. Bank Owner login lands on Executive Dashboard with Total Customers/Liquidity/Transactions/Active Branches/Loan Pipeline/Rating/CAR/NPA tiles and Rate & Policy Configuration section. Two minor design/spec deviations found: (a) the 2nd and 3rd card tiles use orange gradient colors (#f26722 RuPay orange + #f79e1b Mastercard yellow) which visually contradicts the 'NO orange color anywhere' mandate — even though those are the real brand colors; (b) the UPI-on-Debit-Card tab label says 'Launch Tomorrow' but the spec asks for a 'LAUNCHING TOMORROW' red badge on the tab (the launch banner inside the tab does correctly say 'LAUNCHING TOMORROW'). No blocking issues; brute-force fix confirmed working.

ui_bugs.issue: RuPay tile gradient (from-[#0b4481] via-[#008752] to-[#f26722]) and Mastercard tile gradient (from-[#eb001b] via-[#f79e1b] to-[#c8102e]) include orange/amber colors. The spec explicitly says 'NO orange color anywhere'. Consider recoloring RuPay tile to a deep-green/blue combo and Mastercard tile to a red/crimson gradient without #f79e1b amber.
UPI tab is labelled 'Launch Tomorrow' — spec requires a red 'LAUNCHING TOMORROW' badge on the tab (the inner banner is correct).

issues: Orange in RuPay/Mastercard card gradients conflicts with the deep-blue + crimson-only palette required by problem statement

Change the UPI tab badge text from 'Launch Tomorrow' to 'LAUNCHING TOMORROW' (red) to match the spec exactly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L611-612: X-Forwarded-For fallback now correctly used for brute-force identifier AND audit_logs.ip — verified via test_new_features::test_brute_force_lockout_at_five_attempts (6th attempt returns 429).
server.py is ~1727 lines; splitting into routers (auth/accounts/cards/upi/panels/hostinger/admin) would drastically improve maintainability.
CardsChequesPage.js is 596 lines — consider extracting <CardTile>, <UpiTab>, <ChequeTab> into subcomponents.

server.py L994 uses `await db.list_collection_names()` inside a `find(...)` conditional — this always incurs an extra DB round-trip on every staff-panel call; cheap fix is to just do `await db.tickets.find({}).to_list(20)` (Mongo returns [] for missing collection).
In `_require_roles` the 403 message leaks the required role list; safe here (internal panels) but consider generic message for public endpoints.

rca of the issue: The X-Forwarded-For fix in server.py login handler (L611-612) resolves the earlier lockout drift. Behind the k8s ingress the XFF header consistently identifies the same client, so the per-identifier counter now increments once per real failed attempt, causing the 6th attempt to correctly return 429. Confirmed by test_new_features::test_brute_force_lockout_at_five_attempts (all first 5 attempts = 401, 6th = 429).
